hashScope: SHA-256 values are of the committed Git blob bytes (LF-normalized). PNG captures are binary and byte-exact. Python-written JSON can appear CRLF in a Windows worktree; hash the committed blob, not the worktree copy.
isolation: Each suite launches apps/gemini-ui/electron/main.cjs with an isolated --knoux-user-data profile; fixtures live under %TEMP%; no owner paths are touched.
testHarnessFixes: Restored the UTF-8 em dash in the exact-approval dialog mock; commit d12b488 had stored mojibake and the mock rejected the real dialog.

Visual runner captures through webContents.capturePage with bounded retries; Playwright page.screenshot intermittently failed with CDP Page.captureScreenshot errors and also reset the Electron zoom factor.
Visual runner removes the artificial 160 MB renderer heap cap; the Node runner keeps its own 160 MB limit.
